checks.explanation: Trump did not win reelection in November 2020. Joe Biden won decisively, 306-232 in the Electoral College and by 4.4 points (51.3% to 46.8%) in the popular vote, despite the stimulus (CARES Act) passing.

sources.title: Electoral college confirms Joe Biden's victory, 306 to 232

checks.explanation: True US COVID-19 infection counts in March 2020 were far higher than confirmed cases. A Clinical Infectious Diseases study found more than 1.3 million actual infections by the week of March 21, 2020, versus only 17,450 confirmed cases that week (roughly 75x), and CDC seroprevalence-based estimates from later in 2020 similarly found true infections were on the order of 10x or more the confirmed case count.

sources.title: Unmasking the Actual COVID-19 Case Count
